decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit stayed on its own page across 2023 and 2024, which suggests a good fit with the firm's established process knowledge and enough learning from early market feedback to justify continued commercialization.

The orthopedic shoe last is a newer but closely adjacent product that likely builds on the firm's existing custom-form and fabrication capabilities, so management would usually keep it while refining it through accumulated know-how.

The post-curing unit appears less strongly committed commercially because it is only mentioned on the website, but it still fits an adjacent manufacturing workflow the firm can understand and improve, so it is more likely to be retained than dropped.
